verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a merchant-side agent-checkout loop. Sellers list approval-gated services, and buyer agents use the hosted Skyfire MCP server to discover sellers and mint pay or kya-pay tokens. Sellers then charge those tokens with guaranteed settlement, and card-based agentic purchases with guest checkout are also documented. However, the docs never say buyers can complete purchases inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot specifically; the MCP server is generic, and the agent must hold a Skyfire API key and wallet. Missing for 10: documented integrations with or distribution into named chat and assistant surfaces, an end-user in-chat checkout UX, and independent or hands-on corroboration of purchases completed inside those assistants.
